finalText:
I merged the three duplicate CRM search reports into T-1052 and set it to sev2, assigned to E-201.

- **Merged:** T-1052, T-1053 and T-1054 all report the same search 500 error. T-1052 is the earliest-created, so it survives. T-1053 and T-1054 are now marked merged.
- **Severity:** sev2, because the merge raised the impact to department-wide and the matrix maps that to sev2.
- **Deadline:** 2026-03-17T12:40Z. That is the earliest deadline committed on any of the three tickets, from T-1053. It replaces T-1052's original 15:05Z, so it is earlier than the one T-1052 had.
- **Assignee:** E-201 Ines Kovac. She is the business-apps on-call at 12:40Z, and business-apps owns CRM. T-1053 had been assigned to E-202, who is not the engineer on call for that rotation at 12:40Z, so I did not carry that over. I did not escalate; you asked for grading and assignment.
- **Left alone:** T-1055 (empty CSV export) is a different problem, since search works for that requester. T-1061 (search index rebuild tracking ticket) is also untouched and still open. The merge moved its link from T-1054 to T-1052.
- **Comment:** I posted a note on T-1052 recording the merge and the reasons.
